# UAVSim third-party notices

UAVSim includes the following unmodified open-source libraries. The accompanying license files retain their copyright notices and terms. `VERSIONS.md` records the exact versions, revisions and checked download hashes used by this build.

| Library | Included license files | Corresponding source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Eigen 5.0.0 | `eigen/COPYING.README`, `eigen/COPYING.MPL2`, `eigen/COPYING.BSD`, `eigen/COPYING.MINPACK` | [Official 5.0.0 source archive](https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/archive/5.0.0/eigen-5.0.0.tar.gz), revision `549bf8c75b6aae071cde2f28aa48f16ee3ae60b0` |
| nlohmann/json 3.12.0 | `nlohmann-json/LICENSE.MIT` | [Official v3.12.0 source](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0) |
| PicoSHA2 | `picosha2/LICENSE` | [Exact source revision](https://github.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2/tree/161cb3fc4170fa7a3eca9e582cebd27cc4d1fe29) |

Eigen source is available under MPL-2.0 and the compatible notices included with the applicable files. The unmodified headers used by UAVSim are also retained in the public [UAVSim repository's third_party directory](https://github.com/timmyc07/drone_emulator/tree/main/third_party). No changes to these library sources are included in this build.

These notices cover the libraries listed above. Unreal Engine, its runtime components, and supplied visual assets retain their separate applicable licenses and notices; the library licenses do not grant rights to those assets or change the product's licensing.
